The November miasma pursued me from the mews, an insidious dampness vanquished by the sepulchral chill of Lord Harrington's study. I am no stranger to morbid spectacles, yet this one promised to etch itself upon my memory. All within was pristine: the unmarred desk, the man himself possessed of a placid mien in his wingback chair, a sanguine rose clasped in his hand.
